name: Análisis de Parpadeo
description: Detects temporal flicker patterns characteristic of AI video generation.
useCase: Identifying frame-by-frame AI generation through flicker detection
mechanism: Detects micro-oscillation patterns where pixel intensity alternates rapidly. AI-generated frames often exhibit this flicker due to independent frame generation.
source: Frank et al. (2020) - Leveraging Frequency Analysis, ICML
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Frank et al. (2020) - Leveraging Frequency Analysis, ICML
